description.content:
Lob's URL shortener allows you to generate unique short links, either with Lob's own domain or your own custom domains. Each custom link enables Lob to track mail individually and provide customers the relevant tracking data in their dashboard. Webhooks can be used to integrate Lob's URL Shortener scans into your omni channel marketing stratergy. See the Webhooks section of our documentation to learn how to enable the `letter.viewed`, `postcard.viewed` and `self_mailer.viewed` event notifications for your mail pieces. Furthermore, you can use our Retrieve endpoints to track the impact and engagement rate of links created.
